class.name: GameInputForceFeedbackEffect
class.brief_description: A force-feedback effect playing on one motor of a [GameInputDevice].
class.description:
[GameInputForceFeedbackEffect] wraps an [code]IGameInputForceFeedbackEffect[/code] created with [method GameInputDevice.create_force_feedback_effect]. Like [GameInputDevice] it only stores an id; once the effect is released, [method is_valid] returns [code]false[/code] and every other method returns a safe default. An effect is released when [method release] is called, when the last reference to it goes away, when its device disconnects, and at [method GameInput.shutdown]. A new effect is stopped. Play it with [method start], and change it while it plays with [method set_params] and [method set_gain]. Parameters are a [Dictionary]. [code]kind[/code] is an [enum EffectKind] value; it is required when creating the effect and cannot change afterwards. Keys that are left out keep their defaults, or their current values in [method set_params]. Unknown keys, values of the wrong type and non-finite numbers are rejected: the call fails and warns with the reason. Durations are in seconds. [constant EFFECT_CONSTANT], [constant EFFECT_RAMP] and the periodic kinds accept the envelope keys: - [code]attack_duration[/code], [code]sustain_duration[/code] and [code]release_duration[/code]: the length of each phase. A negative [code]sustain_duration[/code], the default, sustains until the effect is stopped. - [code]attack_gain[/code], [code]sustain_gain[/code] and [code]release_gain[/code]: the gain at the start of the attack, during sustain and at the end of the release, in [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]; default [code]1.0[/code]. - [code]play_count[/code]: how many times the envelope plays, a whole number, default [code]1[/code]. [code]repeat_delay[/code]: the pause between plays. [constant EFFECT_CONSTANT] takes [code]magnitude[/code]. [constant EFFECT_RAMP] takes [code]start_magnitude[/code] and [code]end_magnitude[/code]. The periodic kinds, [constant EFFECT_SINE_WAVE] to [constant EFFECT_SAWTOOTH_DOWN], take [code]magnitude[/code], [code]frequency[/code] (hertz, at least [code]0[/code], default [code]1.0[/code]), [code]phase[/code] and [code]bias[/code] (in [code][-1.0, 1.0][/code]). The condition kinds, [constant EFFECT_SPRING] to [constant EFFECT_INERTIA], have no envelope. They take [code]magnitude[/code], [code]positive_coefficient[/code] and [code]negative_coefficient[/code] (in [code][-1.0, 1.0][/code], default [code]1.0[/code]), [code]max_positive_magnitude[/code] and [code]max_negative_magnitude[/code] (in [code][0.0, 1.0][/code], default [code]1.0[/code]), [code]dead_zone[/code] (in [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]) and [code]bias[/code] (in [code][-1.0, 1.0][/code]). A magnitude is either a [float], applied along every axis the motor supports (or [constant FEEDBACK_AXIS_LINEAR_X] if the motor reports none), or a [Dictionary] with any of [code]linear_x[/code], [code]linear_y[/code], [code]linear_z[/code], [code]angular_x[/code], [code]angular_y[/code], [code]angular_z[/code] and [code]normal[/code]. Magnitudes are clamped to [code][-1.0, 1.0][/code], and the other ranged values to their ranges. [codeblock] var bump: GameInputForceFeedbackEffect
func play_bump() -> void: var gi = Engine.get_singleton("GameInput") var wheel: GameInputDevice = gi.get_primary_device(GameInput.DEVICE_RACING_WHEEL) if wheel == null or wheel.get_force_feedback_motor_count() == 0: return bump = wheel.create_force_feedback_effect(0, { "kind": GameInputForceFeedbackEffect.EFFECT_CONSTANT, "magnitude": 0.4, "sustain_duration": 0.25, }) if bump: bump.start() [/codeblock] Keep a reference to an effect for as long as it should play, as [code]bump[/code] does above: when the last reference goes away, the effect is stopped and released.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the effect exists: it has not been released and its device is still connected.

method.name: get_device_id
method.description: Returns the id of the [GameInputDevice] the effect plays on, or [code]0[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: get_motor_index
method.description: Returns the index of the motor the effect plays on, or [code]-1[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: get_kind
method.description: Returns the effect's [enum EffectKind], or [code]-1[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts or resumes the effect. Same as [code]set_state(STATE_RUNNING)[/code].

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the effect; starting it again plays it from the beginning. Same as [code]set_state(STATE_STOPPED)[/code].

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses the effect; starting it again resumes where it paused. Same as [code]set_state(STATE_PAUSED)[/code].

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the effect's [enum EffectState] as GameInput reports it. Returns [constant STATE_STOPPED] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: set_state
method.description: Sets the effect's [enum EffectState]. Returns [code]false[/code] with a warning when [param state] is not an [enum EffectState] value, and [code]false[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: get_gain
method.description: Returns the effect's gain, which scales its magnitudes. Returns [code]0.0[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: set_gain
method.description: Sets the effect's gain, which scales its magnitudes. [param gain] is clamped to [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: get_params
method.description: Returns the effect's parameters in the form [method set_params] accepts: durations in seconds, an unlimited [code]sustain_duration[/code] as [code]-1.0[/code], and every magnitude as a [Dictionary] with all seven axis keys. Returns an empty [Dictionary] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: set_params
method.description: Changes the effect's parameters, including while it plays. [param params] uses the keys listed in the class description; keys that are left out keep their current values. [code]kind[/code] may be included but must match [method get_kind]. Returns [code]false[/code] with a warning when [param params] is invalid or the device rejects the parameters, and [code]false[/code] when the effect is no longer valid.

method.name: release
method.description: Stops and releases the effect now instead of waiting for the wrapper to be freed. Afterwards [method is_valid] returns [code]false[/code]. Safe to call more than once.
